name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.8.0 adds an underground version of the compact two-platform Metro Terminus, using native underground station assets and pedestrian stairs. Both variants use the same tested tram-based reversal and crossover topology, with 80m platforms, a 80 km/h station limit and 40 km/h crossover limit. Connect ordinary electric tramtrack; underground tracks connect in tunnels at 18m depth. The underground placement, tunnel connection and pedestrian access require in-game validation. Existing surface station resource IDs and geometry are preserved. Menu illustrations are generated previews, not screenshots. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
